project.name: LeagueLab
project.summary: Korean-language League of Legends esports stats site: match results, drafts, scoreboards, objectives, gold curves and item builds, team pages, player rankings by position, champion stats and tier lists, pro solo-queue champion builds and weekly reports.

about.text: Korean-language League of Legends esports stats site: match results, drafts, scoreboards, objectives, gold curves and item builds, team pages, player rankings by position, champion stats and tier lists, pro solo-queue champion builds and weekly reports.

languages.text: Korean interface; English Riot non-endorsement disclaimer

updates.text: Ongoing events collected every 30 minutes, full sync once daily (site's own wording)

data_sources.text: Results, drafts and standings come from Leaguepedia; detailed metrics from Riot Match V5 API; custom metrics described on a separate metrics page
